_about: The guards built from the Thursday 5 Nov failure report (docs/learning/2026-11-04-thursday-killed.md), read by scripts/velib/guards.py. Each binds a whole cut of a piece published from creative_direction.MOTION_FROM (9 Nov 2026), like the proof gate. Values here enforce what Krish already approved; an entry with status 'proposed' is built and tested but binds nothing until he says yes.

idea.why: No idea, no production. The signed storyboard names one visual idea, as Monday 2 Nov's motion-system.md did: the one object or system, what each move means, a never-list, and the real artifact where proof exists. Enforces the approved floor groups motion_explains, words_add and real_evidence, and learning visuals-add-not-repeat ('one named motion system per piece, decided before the storyboard').

retype.why: Show the real thing, never re-type it (approved floor group real_evidence: 'Show the real thing: dated screenshots, real products, real interactions'). A device whose on-screen words copy a named real artifact's words is refused; the artifact itself is shown.

engine.why: The engine a storyboard was signed on is the engine that draws its proof and its cut: Thursday's key-frame checks failed by construction while the background, chrome, caption height and colour, chat card width and headline ground changed mid-piece. A change needs Krish's exception approval bound to the new engine hash. The cut's picture and sound paths (conform, takes, words, voice, audio, the quick-edit episode and words gate ve reads, and the voice chain) are in it too, so a mid-piece change to how his take is cut or heard is seen (asked by the predictability session, 4 Nov). The sfx kits and lint.py are left out on purpose: approving a sound during a piece writes the kit and would refuse that piece's own proof and cut, and a cut naming no sound cannot be changed by it; lint cannot change a cut's picture or sound. A path that does not exist yet is simply empty. The render script (apps/renderer/scripts/ve-render.mjs) sets the encoder and colour range every cut is written with, so it is frozen too (the predictability session measured about 0.7 L* between BT.601 full range and BT.709 on his take).

loops.why: docs/ve/RUNBOOK.md: 'Maximum 2 fix loops total'. Thursday rendered at least seven full cuts on 4 Nov. After two full renders of a cut since Krish's last press, the next one waits for a new press: bring him the cut or a question.

type.why: Lists the type treatments a cut shows (a type role on a surface: the caption, its loud word, the held title, a card) on its proof, so they are judged moving, never refused by count. Krish, 2026-11-04, asked whether captions should be one typeface, weight and colour: "No, I just don't think that is true at all. I just think that it needs to look good, and it didn't that time." Experiments are tried carefully on the proof, never by producing whole videos and seeing them fail.

off_day.why: Krish, 2026-11-04: "Yes, give off days their own music and look - Rotate." An off-day piece (published on a day that is not its series' day) beds on a track the music ledger marks for off days (config/music-library.json "for": "off-day", rotated across pieces), wears no series sting, and compile draws it in the house mint, never the series colour or promise.
